# AuPro UI/UX Skills

These project-local skills were copied or adapted from the following repositories after explicit approval:

- anthropics/skills — frontend-design
- xxxxzb/refactoring-ui-skill — refactoring-ui
- oil-oil/oil-ui — oil-ui
- shadcn-ui/ui — shadcn
- pbakaus/impeccable — impeccable
- Nutlope/hallmark — hallmark
- heydamir/unslop — unslop
- nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill — ui-ux-pro-max

The skills are guidance and review workflows. They do not authorize automatic visual decisions. AuPro design choices remain subject to user approval.
